entries: The wearer has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks.
You have one Luck Point per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, a la the {@feat Lucky|XPHB} feat.
This magic weapon grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and it returns to your hand immediately after you use it to make a ranged attack roll.

This magical cube has 3 charges that do not recharge. Once per long rest, a creature may spend a charge as a magic action in order to throw it at any creature of size Huge or smaller within 60ft. The creature must make a Wisdom save (DC 18) or become trapped in the cube.

A creature may be released by any creature who operates the cube and understands how it functions (DC 15 {@skill Arcana|XPHB} check if not). If a creature is released in this fashion, then the cube of confinement will be deactivated, but may be used again after a long rest. Until the creature is released, the cube may not be used again.

While within the cube, the creature exists in a small, colorless demi-plane where their condition is sustained indefinitely. They are free to think and move, but do not need to eat, and are not affected by disease, poison, or any other effects which might do damage to them. While in this state, they may reattempt the initial saving throw once per day in order to break out. This begins 12 hours after being initially trapped. If they break out in this way then the cube loses any remaining charges and becomes permanently nonfunctional.
No matter the size of the creature within, this cube always weighs 0.25lbs.

This item has charges equal to your proficiency bonus. It regains all charges on a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, upon taking damage, you may activate this to teleport away and reduce your damage by (Character Level/3){@dice d4}.

To determine the location teleported to, roll a luck check on a {@dice D20}. The maximum range is 45ft. 10 or less is a bad location determined by the DM, with a nat 1 being the worst location that doesn't instantly damage you. More than 10 is a good location determined by the DM, with a nat 20 being somewhere you get to choose, and you may take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action there.

The dragon's breath weapon is caused by two glands secreting a mix of chemicals together as the dragon exhales. The two glands are wrapped together in a thin membrane or pouch, which can be harvested if careful. Alchemists prize the membrane for the unique mix of chemicals it contains. Magic users prize it for the magic it holds. Artificers prize it for what they can make from it.

Use: The membrane may be thrown up to 20 feet and the pouch explodes upon impact. Any creature within 15 feet of impact must roll a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or suffer 20 (5d8) damage (damage type depends on the dragon the membrane was harvested from).
You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. Additionally, you have advantage on any Stealth checks made to hide while you are in a sandy environment.
Made from tough but flexible leather, studded leather is reinforced with close-set rivets or spikes.

This magic thread is in a state of constant, gentle movement. It is said to be able to channel dream magic. While holding it, a creature may use an action and say one of the following key words in order to do induce its associated effect:
Awaken: Target a creature that is under a magically induced sleep or dream state in order to awaken them from such an effect.
Sleep: Cast Sleep on a target creature. DC 15
Walk: Target a creature that is asleep. The user immediately falls into a sleep-like state and is transported into the target's dream.
Upon being used in this way, the thread magically disperses into a cloud of pastel vapor.
A dark scarf woven from strange shadow-thread that always feels cool to the touch.
While wearing this cloth:
While in dim light or darkness, you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
You learn the Prestidigitation cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.
You can speak, read, and write Shadow Cant, a secretive dialect associated with creatures of shadow and twilight.
A creature may play this flute in the pressence of a beast in order to forge a spiritual bond. The user must succeed on a DC 10 Performance check in order to ellucidate the song of the beasts spriit.

If the beast is wishes to forge this bond, the user adds 5 to this check. If the beast wishis to resist, then the DC is increased by 10, and the user must make this check with disadtantage. Once a bond has succesfully been formed, the user learns a special song that calls out to the beasts spriit.

If the user plays this song on this flute, then the beast will immediately become aware of it, no matter the distance, as long as they exist on the same plane of existence. The beast will be compelled to come to the floutist, unless they were previously instructed to react in some other way.
Once this flute has formed a bond with a beast succesfully, it may not be used to form another bond, unless the bond beast dies, or the user wishis to forget it's spirit song.
